subject: 英语
description: 六年级上册英语核心知识点精华总结

cards.title: 交通方式
cards.definition: 各种出行方式的英语表达。
core_points: 交通工具：bus公交 taxi出租车 plane飞机 ship轮船 subway地铁 train火车 bike自行车
How do you come to school? 你怎么来学校？— I come by bus. / I come on foot.
by + 交通工具（不加the/a）: by bus, by bike, by subway
on foot 步行（特殊，不用by）

example.question: How does your father go to work?
steps: He goes to work by car.
example.answer: He goes to work by car.

mistakes.wrong: by a bus / by the bus
mistakes.correct: by+交通工具中间不加任何冠词: by bus

cards.memory_tip: 🚌 by后面的交通工具都是「光杆」(不加a/the)，唯一特殊的是on foot(脚在地上走)

cards.title: 问路与指路
cards.definition: 用英语问路和给别人指路。
core_points: 问路：Where is the hospital/cinema/bookstore? / How can I get to...?
指路：Go straight. 直走 Turn left/right. 左/右转 It's near/next to/behind... 在...附近/旁边/后面
地点：hospital医院 cinema电影院 bookstore书店 post office邮局 museum博物馆 library图书馆
交通规则：Stop at a red light. Wait at a yellow light. Go at a green light.

example.question: Where is the cinema?
steps: Turn left at the bookstore.在书店左转
It's next to the hospital.在医院旁边
example.answer: Go straight. Turn left at the bookstore. It's next to the hospital.

mistakes.correct: next to: It's next TO the hospital.（不能漏to）

cards.memory_tip: 🧭 方位词记忆：near靠近 next to紧挨着 behind后面 in front of前面 between在...之间

cards.title: 爱好表达
cards.definition: 用英语谈论自己和他人的兴趣爱好。
core_points: 爱好：reading reading books看书 singing唱歌 dancing跳舞 playing football踢足球 cooking做饭 drawing画画
What are your hobbies? 你的爱好是什么？— I like reading. / My hobby is singing.
like + 动词ing: I like swimming. He likes playing basketball.
三单变化：like→likes, do→does, have→has, go→goes

example.question: What are Peter's hobbies?
steps: He likes reading and playing football.
example.answer: He likes reading and playing football.

mistakes.correct: 第三人称单数: He likes swimming.
like后面加动词ing: I like swimming.

cards.memory_tip: 🎨 三单加s记忆：he/she/it做主语时，动词要穿「s」这件衣服

cards.title: 未来职业理想
cards.definition: 学习更多职业词汇，表达未来理想。
core_points: 职业：scientist科学家 pilot飞行员 coach教练 police officer警察 fisherman渔夫 postman邮递员
worker工人 businessman商人 writer作家 singer歌手 dancer舞者
What does he/she want to be? 他/她想成为什么？— He wants to be a pilot.
I'm going to be a/an... 我将来要当...

example.question: What do you want to be?
steps: I want to be a scientist.
example.answer: I want to be a scientist. I like science.

mistakes.correct: 职业前加a/an: a scientist, an artist

units.unit_name: 情绪与一般过去时入门

cards.title: 情绪表达
cards.definition: 用英语表达各种心情和感受。
core_points: 情绪：happy高兴 sad难过 angry生气 afraid害怕 worried担心 ill生病 bored无聊
How do you feel? / How are you? 你感觉怎么样？— I'm happy/sad.
What's wrong? / What's the matter? 怎么了？— I'm ill. / I'm worried about the test.
should应该: You should see a doctor. 你应该看医生。

example.question: Sarah looks sad. What should she do?
steps: She should talk to her friends.
example.answer: She should take a deep breath and talk to her friends.

mistakes.wrong: You should to see a doctor.
mistakes.correct: should后面直接加动词原形，不要to

cards.memory_tip: 😊 feel + 形容词 = 感到...（feel happy/sad/angry就像中文「感到高兴/难过/生气」）

cards.title: 一般过去时入门
cards.definition: 表示过去发生的事情，六年级最核心的语法。
core_points: 结构：主语 + 动词过去式
规则变化：①一般加ed: played ②e结尾加d: liked ③辅+y变ied: studied ④双写+ed: stopped
不规则变化（必背）：is/am→was, are→were, go→went, have→had, do→did, eat→ate, see→saw
时间标志词：yesterday昨天, last week上周, ago...之前

example.question: 用过去式说「昨天我去了公园」
steps: I went to the park yesterday.
example.answer: I went to the park yesterday.

mistakes.wrong: I goed to school.（规则化不规则动词）
He didn't went.（否定句动词还用过去式）

cards.memory_tip: ⏪ 过去时 = 时光倒流键！was/were(是)、went(去)、had(有)、did(做)、ate(吃)、saw(看) ← 先背这6个王牌
